card.name: Words just before a named proper noun
card.fires_on: Linking words such as 'as', 'and', 'classic' or 'wife' right before a well-known name or title, mostly in Tolkien and Greek myth passages. It also fires on the space just before a dose number.

modes.label: Before a famous name
modes.description: A linking or descriptive word comes right before a named author, work or mythic figure.

modes.label: Before a dose number
modes.description: A blank space token comes right before a number in a dose sentence.
modes.example: The effective dosage range is<< >>100 to 450

modes.label: Between list items
modes.description: The word 'and' joins items in a list of tests or titles.
modes.example: such as the despair test, tail suspension test,<< and>> open field test
